Nika Belotserkovskaya’s recipes are now available in an iPhone/iPad app. Popular or unusual, with monthly updates and a multitude of additional features. And of course, “step by step” instructions: You'll never go wrong! You can create a grocery list in it, or send someone a recipe by eMail.

Nika Belotserkovskaya (Belonika) is an editor, writer and mother of three boys. She’s recognized by a large audience, thanks to her blog which quickly became the most popular in Russia’s Internet cooking circles.

She authored the books “Recipkies” and “Dietkies”, which are best-sellers in Russia. In 2010, Nika Belotserkovskaya founded the “Belonika & Les Chefs” cooking school in Provence (France).

The app already contains nearly 100 free recipes. In the future, more will show up from time to time. There are also exclusive pay recipe collections, which can't be found in the blog.
